combined_scene.title: The Severed Choir of Zero Current

patterns.rule: Portal then insulated horizontal nave then altar; maintain a visible void within portal
low buttress prepares eye for twin towers, then radially detailed rose
dry substitutions only in published gallery; active forms independently tested

combined_scene.narrative: The Severed Canticle: a fractured west cantilever and lost choir bridge approaches the suspended double-ring null-cantor dial; unequal piers and a dismantled east transept preserve disconnected, ceremonial remnants of inactive electrical infrastructure. Dry static material geometry only: not real load, host clearing, electricity, light or native physics.

alternate_scene.title: The Unpowered Reliquary of the Lower Choir
alternate_scene.narrative: A descending mortuary power sanctuary with broken insulating corona, eight altars across unequal elevations and excavated cable undercroft; no functioning power, liquid or light. Lower flanking bedrock is breached by six unequal archival vaults: broken bus couplers, stranded rectifiers, a harmonic spool, severed return switchboard, damaged pendulum ledger and a triptych of terminal coffins. Their apertures are actual unstamped source-cell geometry, with interrupted stone load paths and local maintenance shafts; no host clearing, power, collision or physics is implied.
